findings.summary: Idempotent create replay returns the receipt without reauthorizing the persisted resolved reviewer; revoked Principal or sensitive-domain view Grant still replays successfully.
Receipts created by base 9cadf1c cannot replay because adding reviewerRoleSlotKey changes the fingerprint and the legacy path excludes normal base-era Task views.
Malformed reviewerRoleSlotKey throws a plain error and Product API maps it to 502 instead of stable 422 validation failure.
diff.json incorrectly reports publicHttpOrUiChange false despite the new public Task request field.

testsAndProbes: Product API and canonical client suites 25/25 passed
revoked reviewer Principal replay incorrectly succeeded
revoked sensitive-domain view Grant replay incorrectly succeeded
exact base-era receipt replay incorrectly failed with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED_WITH_DIFFERENT_PAYLOAD
malformed public slot key returned 502 while wrong type and non-acceptance usage returned 422
nextAction: Reauthorize the stored resolved reviewer on replay without rerunning resolution, support the immediate previous fingerprint when slot key is null/omitted, map slot-key validation to 422, correct evidence metadata, add regressions and rerun gates.
